export.compile_and_link_settings:
F90 = /usr/local/bin/ifort
COMMS = serial
FCOPTS = -O2
LDOPTS = -O2 -Wl,-rpath,/opt/intel/mkl/lib
LIBS = -L/opt/intel/mkl/lib -lmkl_core -lmkl_intel_lp64 -lmkl_sequential -lpthread
